mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking ( user_id, user_name, room_id, room_name, date, start_time, end_time, subject, attendee_count, remark, status, sign_in_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{roomId}, #{roomName}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{subject}, #{attendeeCount}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{signInTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE booking SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
